title: MSIC
description: This table provides a complete lookup for the MSIC (Malaysian Standard Industrial Classification) 2008, as applied and used in data publications in Malaysia. The MSIC is primarily used by the Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM), for the purpose of categorising economic data, such as during the production of GDP data.

fields.name: digits
fields.title: Digits
fields.description: [Integer] Number of digits; this column can be used as a filter if you only want to keep 2 digit codes, for example

fields.name: section
fields.title: Section
fields.description: [String] 1-digit code; unlike the 2 to 5-digit codes, this is a letter rather than than a number

fields.name: division
fields.title: Division
fields.description: [String] 2-digit code; please ensure that you read this column as a string, because the (intentional) leading zeroes will be dropped if read as an integer (e.g. upon opening in Microsoft Excel)

fields.name: group
fields.title: Group
fields.description: [String] 3-digit code, with dashes where not applicable (e.g. for rows providing 2-digit definitions)

fields.name: class
fields.title: Class
fields.description: [String] 4-digit code, with dashes where not applicable (e.g. for rows providing 2 and 3-digit definitions)

fields.name: item
fields.title: Item
fields.description: [String] 5-digit code, with dashes where not applicable (e.g. for rows providing 2, 3, and 4-digit definitions)

fields.name: desc_en
fields.title: Description (EN)
fields.description: [String] Description for the code, in English

fields.name: exclude_en
fields.title: Exclusions (EN)
fields.description: [String] List of inclusions, in English, provided for avoidance of doubt

fields.name: include_en
fields.title: Inclusions (EN)
fields.description: [String] List of exclusions, in English, provided for avoidance of doubt

fields.name: desc_bm
fields.title: Description (BM)
fields.description: [String] Description for the code, in Malay

fields.name: exclude_bm
fields.title: Exclusions (BM)
fields.description: [String] List of inclusions, in Malay, provided for avoidance of doubt

fields.name: include_bm
fields.title: Inclusions (BM)
fields.description: [String] List of exclusions, in Malay, provided for avoidance of doubt

methodology: The MSIC was adapted from the [ISIC published by the United Nations Statistics Division](https://unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Econ/isic), which is used as a global reference for the classification of economic activities.
